# Bag2Bag

> > Bag2Bag is India's homestay and service apartment booking platform offering budget-friendly accommodations across Karnataka, Kerala, Uttarakhand, Goa, and other regions with flexible stay options.

Bag2Bag specializes in couple-friendly homestays and service apartments with features like hourly stays, pay-at-hotel options, local ID acceptance, and significant discounts. The platform serves travelers seeking authentic local experiences in destinations like Coorg, Wayanad, Chikmagaluru, and major cities across India.
